name: nethermind
description: AI-powered network switch management — multi-vendor SSH + serial, Jinja2 templates, AI agent, and security auditing.
what_it_does: Full-stack web app for managing network switches: SSH/serial connections, 50+ config templates, AI chat assistant, workflow engine, security auditing, and config diff/rollback.

features.title: Multi-Vendor Support
features.description: Manage Cisco, HP Aruba, Juniper, Arista, and Linux devices.

features.title: SSH & Serial Console
features.description: Connect via Netmiko (SSH), serial console (COM/USB), or Telnet.

features.title: 50+ Jinja2 Templates
features.description: Built-in configuration templates for Aruba, Cisco, and generic network tasks.

features.title: Config Parser
features.description: Parse existing running-config files into structured data for editing and re-rendering.

features.title: IRIS-Style Workflow Engine
features.description: Disciplined configuration change management with approval gates.

features.title: AI Chat Assistant
features.description: OpenAI-powered chat with tool calling for natural-language network operations.

features.title: Security Auditing
features.description: CVE scanning, AAA checks, CIS/NIST compliance auditing.

features.title: Config Diff & Rollback
features.description: Compare config versions, track changes, and restore previous configs.

author: Jhonattan L. Jimenez (OneByJorah)
